summary: Americas Gold and Silver Corporation filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 18, 2026, furnishing a news release announcing high-grade silver-copper-lead-antimony drill results from its Galena Complex in Idaho. The filing is an operational update, not a special situation. The company reported a new Galena Mine vein discovery grading 1,062 g/t Ag over 1.3 meters and Crescent drilling intercepts of 1,891 g/t Ag over 1.3 meters and 1,560 g/t Ag over 1.1 meters. The terms are technical assay results, not financial. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are included. The key angle is exploration upside potential; no risk-arb event is present.
